```yaml
name: Helm Chart CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
    paths:
      - 'helm/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'helm/**'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout chart repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Helm lint
        run: |
          helm lint helm/falkordb-browser

  test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout chart repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Setup Kind cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@0025e74a8c7512023d06dc019c617aa3cf561fde
        with:
          config: |
            kind: Cluster
            apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
            nodes:
              - role: control-plane
            networking:
              kubeProxyMode: "iptables"

      - name: Install chart into Kind
        run: |
          helm repo add local . --force-update
          helm install test-release helm/falkordb-browser --namespace test --create-namespace
          kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app.kubernetes.io/name=falkordb-browser -n test --timeout=120s

      - name: Upload test artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@6f51ac03b9356f520e9adb1b1b7802705f340c2b
        with:
          name: test-logs
          path: /tmp

  publish:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GHCR_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout chart repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout helm-charts repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: FalkorDB/helm-charts
          token: ${{ env.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          path: helm-charts
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install yq
        run: |
          YQ_VERSION="v4.40.5"
          YQ_SHA256="c1b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5b1e5b9c5b1e5b9"
          curl -L https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_amd64 -o /usr/local/bin/yq
          echo "${YQ_SHA256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c -
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq

      - name: Set chart version from tag
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          yq eval -i ".version = \"${TAG}\"" helm/falkordb-browser/Chart.yaml
          yq eval -i ".appVersion = \"${TAG}\"" helm/falkordb-browser/Chart.yaml

      - name: Package chart
        run: |
          helm package helm/falkordb-browser -d charts

      - name: Copy chart to helm-charts repo
        run: |
          cp charts/falkordb-browser-*.tgz helm-charts/charts/

      - name: Update Helm repo index
        run: |
          cd helm-charts
          helm repo index . --url https://falkordb.github.io/helm-charts

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@0b5e5c
        with:
          github_token: ${{ env.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: FalkorDB/helm-charts
          branch: main
          directory: helm-charts
          force: true
```
